dedupe_keys.name: earthing fault level data for grid and primary sites

description: Earthing Fault Level Data for Grid and Primary Sites is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. The earthing fault level dataset includes the three-phase and single-phase to earth fault levels for all Grid (132kV, 66kV, 33kV) and Primary (33kV, 20kV, 11kV, 6.6kV) substations based on the UK Power Networks Long Term Development Statement (LTDS). This data can be used in substation earthing system design and assessment. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network Infrastructure. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
